measure_sets.set_name: dev in-sample (193 documents): D1 labels of the floor F1
measure_sets.interval_method: document bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20261013, 5 % and 95 % quantiles (criteria 6.3)

floor-v1.switch.rule_path.reference_source: AI reference E20 v4.1 (daten/iso/v4/ref41 and daten/iso/v4/pool_ref41, mapped to the options of criteria 2.2) with the pilot overrides of 879163, 375917 and 549658
floor-v1.switch.rule_path.calibration_note: switch boundary of the rule block path (criteria 2.5): Jeffreys posterior mean of the precision on the dev reference switch boundaries; a gap without a switch label has the switch probability p_gap_without_label in the measures (criteria 6.2 item 11). In a cascade run this record is used only for a document without states (criteria chapter 4 item 7): it has no threshold a, so each label of such a document is unsure.

measure_sets.set_name: dev in-sample (193 documents): all gaps between two blocks, switch probability of the floor F1
measure_sets.interval_method: document bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20261013, 5 % and 95 % quantiles (criteria 6.3)

measure_sets.set_name: dev AI-reference documents, in-sample (fit set of the map)

gj1-r2-platt-step0b.calibration_note: R2 step 0b (criteria 8.4 item 2): Platt map of q(yes) of the frozen head H (layer 16) on the Docling text; fit on the 193 dev AI-reference documents; threshold a by P17 on the out-of-fold values of the map (criteria 8.6 item 4); GJ.14 on validation sets the target status
